visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and a black cap stands on a raised platform at a baseball stadium. She wears a white jersey with orange and red flame patterns and white pants. She holds a black microphone and moves her arms enthusiastically while leading a chant. Behind her, a protective net separates her from a large crowd seated in blue stadium chairs under bright natural daylight. (2) The camera angle changes to a side view of the same cheerleader. She continues her rhythmic movements, pointing her hand towards the spectators while smiling broadly. The crowd includes various individuals in casual attire, some taking photos or videos. A second cheerleader in a similar white uniform appears partially in the frame, also engaging with the audience through gestures. (3) The scene cuts to a closer medium shot of the primary cheerleader leading the chant. Her facial expressions are animated and joyful. Large yellow and white text overlays appear on the screen, synchronized with her rhythmic speech and movements. The background remains the bustling stadium atmosphere with spectators visible in the depth of field.
